videos.title: Is GTA 6 On Sale for Black Friday? 💸 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
No official GTA 6 Black Friday sale: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told CNBC there's no publisher holiday discount, and PS Store / Microsoft Store still list $79.99 (Standard) and $99.99 (Ultimate). Some third-party key sellers reportedly offer about $10 off.

Sources: CNBC (via TheGamer, Yahoo Tech, GamingBolt), GamesRadar, Beebom
